## Windows setup keeps its reputation
- **Same setup file across releases:** `Streyn.exe` (the Windows setup) is now byte for byte the same file from release to release as long as the desktop app does not change. Before, every server release produced a new setup only because the version number inside it changed, and every virus scanner had to judge a brand-new unsigned file from scratch
- The setup shows the desktop app's version under "Installed apps"

## Install
- **Server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
